snippet.title: Hellrider 2
snippet.description:
Angry skeletons put Hellrider in the tower! But beautiful assistant freed him, and now he is ready to challenge the Skeleton King!
 IOS link https://itunes.apple.com/app/id1067524957
ANDROID link https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.makabaka.hellrider2
- Simple and pleasant to play by one touch!
- Dizzying adventures on land, sea and air!
- Incredible boss fights!
